spec_match.rationale: Mounts <camera>, <microphone>, <usermedia>, and <geolocation> elements with display-mode="icon-only" and icon-variant attributes and probes IDL reflection ('displayMode' in document.createElement('geolocation')).

interactive.rationale: Interactive toggle buttons switch display-mode between icon-only and default and icon-variant between outline and filled, updating both the live DOM nodes and visual toolbar.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index promise: floating video call tray and map control bar toggling display-mode="icon-only" vs default and icon-variant with live IDL reflection probe.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles engines where HTMLGeolocationElement/HTMLUserMediaElement are behind flags by reporting the exact IDL reflection state alongside the visual dock comparison.

references.rationale: Links to chromestatus.com/feature/5107682460696576, W3C Media Capture HTML Elements spec, and explainer.

conformance.rationale: Aligns with geolocation-display-mode-idl-exists and usermedia-display-mode-idl-reflection assertions in conformance.json.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified attribute and IDL reflection table updates, toolbar compaction, and zero console or overflow issues.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits capability-icon-only-tray-probe telemetry recording IDL support, active displayMode, and iconVariant.

design_system.rationale: Uses only /public/styles.css variables, pairs background and color on buttons, and maintains 44x44px minimum target geometry.

accessibility.rationale: Every icon-only capability pill maintains an explicit aria-label matching the UA accessible name ('Use camera', 'Use microphone', 'Share location').

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Flex-wrap dock and 44x44px icon-only buttons fit cleanly on a 360px mobile viewport without horizontal scroll.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Icon-only buttons must always provide an accessible name via aria-label or UA-supplied text equivalent.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every compact capability button in icon-only mode retains an explicit accessible name ('Use camera', 'Use microphone', 'Share location').

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group configuration toggles inside semantic <fieldset> and <legend> containers with 44px minimum hit targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped display-mode and icon-variant controls in <fieldset>/<legend> blocks with min-height: 44px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use flex-wrap and responsive auto-fit grids so dense toolbars never overflow mobile screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Used display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap on the dock bar so both default and icon-only states remain within 360px viewports.

summary: Interactive video call and map capability tray toggling display-mode="icon-only" and icon-variant across <camera>, <microphone>, <usermedia>, and <geolocation>.
